title.zh: 将数据流变为多个不相交区间

desc.zh: 从缺失的一个整数出发，推导有序区间的双邻居合并。
desc.en: Fill one missing integer to derive a sorted interval summary and two-neighbor merging.

complexity: addNum O(k+1) worst-case time; getIntervals O(k+1) time; O(k+1) space, k = current interval count

concepts.name: Maximal disjoint intervals
concepts.description: Derive exact coverage, sorted starts and a missing-integer gap.

concepts.name: Two-neighbor insertion
concepts.description: Binary-search a start and inspect both neighboring ranges.
